scope: 61 current games in the review index; spreadsheet numbering preserved. No.23–40 inspected from the authoritative 2026-09-28-batch23-40-initial folder.
limitations: Read-only inspection of active entry scripts, inline configuration and CSS. No game files changed.
Local browser rendering is restricted; no rendered overlap/clipping or complete interaction pass is claimed.
Unused config strings, old hidden bundles and unused styles are not treated as visible game UI.
Keep central gameplay timers, targets/questions, material/tool labels and outcome messages when they are essential.
